analysis:
Examined both PlacementSetupCheck.swift excerpts and the complete file patch. The only changed test (head lines 1260–1264, visible in the patch) supplies publicModels: [] to publicTrafficLine, explicitly isolating qualification-record behavior from public declarations. It still expects an unpassed pipeline family to remain unqualified and a passed hand-off family to be qualified. This test-only change does not independently establish a security regression.
BASE lines 1263–1420 distinguish owner serving from public grants and test diverged shapes, ignored malformed records, and artifact-bound qualification. HEAD lines 43–60 retain capability-hash checking before setup synthesis; lines 125–172 and 187–318 exercise opt-in validation and release refusal of developer overrides. No supplied change modifies request encryption, cache isolation (T-041), credentials, attestation, billing, or local privileged boundaries.
Integration must examine the changed publicTrafficLine implementation and publicModels declaration handling: determine whether declarations merely affect display or can confer routing permission without applicable qualification/artifact evidence. That contract is not visible here and is material to output integrity (T-007/T-027) and avoiding overclaimed qualification (T-054/T-056); cluster model qualification must not be conflated with App Attest build authorization. Tests and comments alone do not prove either a bypass or runtime enforcement. No production callers were examined.
